title: Pistachio carbonara
creator: aldentedreams
steps: Mix the egg yolks, Pecorino and black pepper into a thick paste and set aside.
Fry the pistachios gently in the olive oil until fragrant and lightly toasted.
Blend the pistachios until smooth, then add a ladle of pasta water to loosen it into a cream.
Cook the pasta until al dente, keeping some of the water.
Warm the pistachio cream in a pan with a splash of pasta water, add the pasta and toss.
Turn off the heat, add the yolk mixture and toss vigorously, adding pasta water until creamy.
notes: The caption lists the Pecorino twice (in the yolk paste and the pistachio cream). One cup in total is used here.
